newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Petrofields board approves capital boost.
newsitem.headline: Petrofields board approves capital boost.

text.p: Oil exploration firm Petrofields Exploration & Development Co Inc said on Monday its board of directors has approved an increase in the company's authorised capital from 800 million pesos to 1.6 billion pesos.
Petrofields president Milagros Reyes said in a statement to the Philippine Stock Exchange that the capital increase will be required to finance the company's diversification programme.
The board also approved the change in the principal purpose of the oil exploration company to a development and investment management firm.
Reyes said that oil assets of Petrofields will be transferred to a wholly-owned subsidiary, PetroTech Consultants Inc.
The company will submit the board's decisions to stockholders for approval on April 23, the statement said.
